# Globe Radio

> Globe Radio is a free web app that turns a 3D globe into a world-band radio tuner: spin the Earth and tune into thousands of live radio stations across every continent.

Key facts:
- [Cost]: Free, no account, no installation — runs in the browser
- [Platforms]: Any modern browser, desktop and mobile
- [Data source]: Radio Browser, a community database of internet radio streams
- [Coverage]: Up to 10,000 stations with known coordinates pinned to the globe at once
- [Maps]: MapLibre GL globe projection with MapTiler satellite imagery
- [Shortcuts]: Space = play/pause, ← → = previous/next station, Enter = jump to a random city

How it works:
1. Spin the globe to any region
2. Stations near the crosshair load automatically
3. Tap any green dot to listen

GitHub: https://github.com/huanglizhuo/globe-radio
App: https://gradio.clothpath.com/
